notes.title: Demo update 2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I've received some feedback and tried to make the tanks more visible and reworked some enemies.
Please let me know if there are enemies that are way to strong or not fun to fight.

Next update I will add more common items to the store and rework the tavern.

notes.title: Demo update 1 (Version 0.5.2)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

For everyone who played the start of the demo here is an update:

-Fixed poison clicks (Buying item with poison clicks on them will now deal poison on the enemy)
-Fixed thief passive enemies will now give +15 gold.

-Added flavor text to all items
-Tweaked enemies and items

notes.title: Demo has arrived!!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 
Welcome to the demo!


Today I've released the demo which will be open to everyone. The demo will consist of only 1 act to represent how the game works. Hope to receive lots of feedback. From here on the demo will get updated regularly. While we're working towards the early access release which will have 3 acts, 3 characters and a bunch of unlockable items.

notes.title: Close to demo!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Enemies are more varied than ever, enemies have more types of attacks, buffs, debuffs and types like tanks, thorn shield etc.

I will now work on polishing some last stuff and reworking the inventory/shop system.

Demo is on it's way coming either  3rd of July or 10th of July.

Have a great day everyone! If there is questions feel free to join discord or discussions on steam.

notes.title: Game progress!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

First off sorry for being quiet for awhile. I've been working on the game and have updated and added lots of new features.

First off the current state of the game;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591715/913eeaf555268d02218bbf11c43b02df3c0f9c27.jpg[/img]

Enemies have been remade and have more types now. Every battle will be more varied.
The UI has been reworked and I've added a new currency system called "Gems" these gems can be used to unlock new character, items and alternative characters (Alternative characters are the different version of current characters as example thief's alternative character is the assassin)

Also I added new debuff and buff system I call it the stack system.
All buffs and debuffs work on a stack system. I will explain more on stack system in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591715/a9498871e9335f312a88031ec45ebf668c06ffe5.png[/img]

There is still quite some work to do. I'll keep everyone updated on the progress and a potential release date will follow.
